question: What shape does a capability page take at the directional depth, with no features written?
answer: Title, Directional intent, Sources, then the Agent intent (ICE) as the last section. There is no Features heading at this stage, so the page says in a Features line inside its text that none are written yet.

trace.asked: the required headings of a directional capability page
trace.found: the directional stage requires only the title and Directional intent

trace.asked: where Sources and the agent intent sit, and what the ICE lines are
trace.found: Sources comes after the other sections and before the agent intent; the agent intent is the last section at every stage
